component.name: ethers
component.description: Vendored UMD bundle used by tools/live-signer.mjs and src/brickken-live-signer.mjs for offline transaction signing. It is not an npm dependency of this project: package.json declares none, and .github/dependabot.yml tracks only github-actions, so no automated updater or advisory feed sees this file or the libraries bundled inside it (MD-07).

properties.name: mandate-desk:versionSource
properties.value: the literal string "6.17.0" is present in the minified bundle text, and vendor/ethers-6.17.0/artifact-manifest.json records this file's sha256 (matching the hash above) as extracted from package/dist/ethers.umd.min.js of the published ethers npm package. During the 2026-09-26 hostile audit this byte content was independently compared against the ethers-io/ethers.js GitHub release tag v6.17.0 (commit 3ea4c226dd0b3a074abf90748de9d11192027f4f) and matched byte for byte (526551 bytes).

properties.name: mandate-desk:advisoryStatus
properties.value: the ethers-io/ethers.js GitHub Security Advisories page reported no published advisories as of 2026-09-26; see ADVISORIES.md in this folder for how to recheck.

properties.name: mandate-desk:versionSource
properties.value: bundled transitively inside ethers.umd.min.cjs; the minified bundle carries no readable version string for this transitive dependency (grepped for x.y.z-shaped literals during this SBOM's own preparation: only ethers' own "6.17.0" was found). The version 1.3.2 is taken from the upstream ethers v6.17.0 release's own source map (dist/ethers.umd.js.map) and its package.json dependency list, read during the 2026-09-26 hostile audit against the official GitHub release. It has not been independently re-derived from bytes inside this repository, because that would need a network fetch of the upstream release, which this offline environment does not perform.
